docs.c01:
User: app bị crash khi resize cửa sổ, log báo index out of bounds trong text layout
Assistant: The panic comes from slicing a string at a byte offset inside a multi-byte character. `&label[..n]` cuts in the middle of 'ế'. Use `label.char_indices()` to find a boundary:
```rust
let end = label.char_indices().nth(n).map(|(i, _)| i).unwrap_or(label.len());
```
docs.c02:
User: Why does scrolling up from the bottom of the chat do nothing for almost a second?
Assistant: `ListRows::sync` runs on every draw and snaps the list back to the end whenever it is within 24 pt of it. Each trackpad step is 1 to 5 pt, so the next draw undoes it. Only go to the end when content under the reader changed.
docs.c04:
User: The daemon dies right after the app starts it, ensure_daemon times out
Assistant: The daemon read the whole session list before binding the socket, which took longer than the 3 s wait in ensure_daemon, so the app killed it. Bind first, then read sessions; sessions.list waits up to 4 s.
docs.c05:
User: làm sao để đổi tài khoản Claude Code mà không bị đăng xuất phiên đang chạy?
Assistant: Never refresh a token that a running session uses: refresh tokens rotate, so the session holding the old one gets signed out. Switch by swapping the saved login only when Claude Code is not running.
docs.c06:
User: add a dark theme toggle to the settings sheet
Assistant: The app follows the system appearance today. A toggle needs a stored key `appearance` with `system`, `light`, `dark`, and every window must observe it:
```rust
window.set_appearance(match pref { Pref::Dark => Appearance::Dark, Pref::Light => Appearance::Light, _ => system });
```
docs.c07:
User: SQLite báo database is locked khi hai tiến trình cùng ghi
Assistant: Open it in WAL mode and set a busy timeout so writers wait instead of failing:
```sql
PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;
PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;
```
Keep one writer thread and never hold a transaction across network I/O.
docs.c08:
User: How do I make the FTS search ignore Vietnamese accents?
Assistant: Create the table with `tokenize = "unicode61 remove_diacritics 2"`. Then 'dang nhap' matches 'đăng nhập', except for đ, which Unicode does not decompose, so fold đ to d yourself before indexing and querying.
docs.c09:
User: cargo deny check fails with an unmaintained advisory for paste
Assistant: paste comes in through gpui's metal dependency. It is a proc macro used only at build time. Add it to `[advisories] ignore` with its id and a reason, so a new advisory still fails.
docs.c10:
User: tại sao CPU lên 87% khi mở một session lớn?
Assistant: The Details Panel recomputed each subagent row on the main thread by parsing the 4 MB tail of its transcript. With more than 30 subagents the cursor cache missed every time. Move the reads to the loader and cache them by size and mtime.
docs.c12:
User: the phone can't connect to the Mac over the bridge, TLS handshake fails
Assistant: The bridge listens with TLS on port 47821 only while the bridge switch is on. Check that the phone was paired after the certificate was regenerated; an old pairing pins the old certificate.
docs.c13:
User: giải thích giúp mình reciprocal rank fusion
Assistant: RRF adds 1/(k + rank) from each ranked list, usually with k = 60. It needs no score normalization, which is why it works well for combining bm25 with vector similarity.
docs.c14:
User: The spinner keeps the CPU busy even when nothing changes
Assistant: GPUI's animation asked for a frame every vsync and each frame laid out the whole conversation. Draw the spinner as a Core Animation layer so the window draws nothing while it turns.
docs.c15:
User: lỗi permission denied khi ghi file vào ~/Library/Application Support
Assistant: The folder was created by another user with sudo. Fix ownership with `sudo chown -R $USER ~/Library/Application\ Support/Notchling` and write files with mode 0600 through `write_private`.
docs.c16:
User: how do I run only the ignored render tests?
Assistant: `cargo test -p notchling-app -- --ignored` runs them. They open real windows, so run them on a Mac with a display, and in release for the bench tests.
docs.c17:
User: mình muốn notch hiển thị số tin nhắn chưa đọc
Assistant: The inbox already keeps an unread count. Show it as a badge on the notch when it is open, not when collapsed, and clear it on `inbox.seen`.
docs.c18:
User: Base64 images in the transcript push the conversation out of the 4 MB window
Assistant: Count the budget in parsed bytes, not file bytes: skip lines longer than the parser's cap without counting them, and look back at most 64 MB.
docs.c19:
User: dịch đoạn này sang tiếng Anh: "Không thể kết nối tới máy chủ, vui lòng thử lại sau"
Assistant: "Unable to connect to the server, please try again later."
docs.c20:
User: Make the Keep Awake mode turn off automatically when the battery is low
Assistant: Read the power source with IOKit's `IOPSCopyPowerSourcesInfo`; when on battery under 20%, release the `IOPMAssertion` and post a notification saying Keep Awake paused.
docs.c21:
User: Docker build bị chậm, mỗi lần đổi code là cài lại toàn bộ dependency
Assistant: Copy the lockfile and install dependencies before copying the source, so that layer is cached:
```dockerfile
COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
RUN cargo fetch
COPY src ./src
```
docs.c22:
User: How should we store the API keys agents need?
Assistant: Keep them in the Secret Vault, backed by the Keychain. An agent asks with `notchling secret-request` and the user approves in the app; the value never goes into settings or files.
docs.c23:
User: regex để kiểm tra email hợp lệ trong Rust
Assistant:
```rust
let re = Regex::new(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$").unwrap();
assert!(re.is_match("a@b.vn"));
```
A regex can't fully validate email; send a confirmation link for that.
docs.c24:
User: git rebase conflict in Cargo.lock, what's the safe way?
Assistant: Take either side, then regenerate: `git checkout --theirs Cargo.lock && cargo update -w`. Never hand-merge a lockfile.
docs.c25:
User: tối ưu truy vấn tìm kiếm cho 50 nghìn vector, có cần HNSW không?
Assistant: At 50k vectors of 384 dimensions a brute-force scan with int8 is about 19M multiply-adds, a few milliseconds. HNSW is worth it near a million vectors.
docs.c26:
User: The hook prints nothing and Claude Code asks in the terminal instead
Assistant: The hook passes when there is no daemon, no app attached, or the acting switch is off. Acting is off at every daemon start until the app turns it on.
docs.c27:
User: viết script Python đọc file CSV và tính tổng cột amount
Assistant:
```python
import csv
with open('data.csv') as f:
    print(sum(float(r['amount']) for r in csv.DictReader(f)))
```
docs.c28:
User: memory keeps growing when the chat window stays open overnight
Assistant: The Markdown cache kept every rendered row. Bound it with an LRU of 500 entries keyed by row id and drop entries for sessions that are closed.
docs.c29:
User: làm sao để agent tự chuyển sang tài khoản khác khi gần hết quota?
Assistant: Set the limit mode to Notify and Switch and choose the percent in Switch at, for example 95. Notchling moves to the next saved account that has room.
docs.c30:
User: Explain what the acting switch protects against
Assistant: Any agent with a shell can write files, so no file may turn on the power to reply, answer or control sessions. Only an app-tier call in the current daemon run turns acting on.
docs.c31:
User: unit test cho việc tách chuỗi thời gian bị fail trên Windows
Assistant: The test builds paths with '/' and compares strings. Use `Path::join` and compare `PathBuf`s, or mark the test `#[cfg(unix)]` if it is Unix-only.
docs.c32:
User: How do I pair the phone app with the Mac?
Assistant: Open Phone in the menu, turn on the bridge, and scan the QR code with the app. The code carries the Mac's address and certificate fingerprint.
docs.c33:
User: embedding model nào hỗ trợ tiếng Việt mà chạy offline được?
Assistant: multilingual-e5-small is MIT licensed, 118M parameters with 384 dimensions, and covers Vietnamese. It needs 'query: ' and 'passage: ' prefixes.
docs.c34:
User: the reply box loses the draft when I switch sessions
Assistant: Drafts are kept per session in notchling.db. Save on every edit with a 300 ms debounce and restore when the session is selected again.
docs.c35:
User: tự động commit và push mỗi khi test pass
Assistant: Agents never push or merge on their own here; the maintainer merges. Add a pre-push hook that runs `cargo test` instead, and push by hand.
docs.c36:
User: Swift app's menu bar icon hides behind the notch on small screens
Assistant: macOS places status items right to left and drops the ones that collide with the notch. Open Chat from the hot key or the Dock instead, or reduce menu bar spacing.
